text:
maya: Heads-up — I'm prototyping a Grafana dashboard to track tenant-level burst headroom + a derived thermal-drift metric. Aim: spot tenants that cause thermal creep during long jobs and tie that to cost impact. Thoughts?
liam: love it. can you add a variable for `region` and `tenant` so ops can scope? also we should show rolling 95p util and a separate instant util panel.
maya: yup — planning variables `region`, `cluster`, `tenant`. main panels: 1) burst headroom (allocatable - used, percent), 2) 95p/mean GPU util, 3) VRAM fragmentation, 4) thermal drift (current_temp - baseline_temp), 5) cost/hr estimate by tenant.
nora: for baseline_temp do we use historical median per-gpu-model? otherwise drift will be noisy when models mix.
maya: yes — baseline is 30d median per model+slot. computed offline and exposed as `gpu_baseline_temp{model=...,node=...}`. drift promql will just be `gpu_temperature_celsius - gpu_baseline_temp` in the dashboard.
diego: can you paste the exact PromQL you're planning? helps when I wire alerts.
maya: sure — sample queries: 
```
# 95th percentile GPU util over 5m per node
quantile_over_time(0.95, rate(gpu_utilization_percent[5m]))

# burst headroom % per node
( (gpu_allocatable_memory_bytes - sum(gpu_memory_used_bytes) by (node)) / gpu_allocatable_memory_bytes ) * 100

# thermal drift per node
gpu_temperature_celsius - gpu_baseline_temp{model="$model"}
```
liam: for the headroom panel, consider using `transformations` to show absolute GB and percent side-by-side — easier for ops to judge eviction risk.
nora: alerts: we should set a warning when drift > 6C for >10m and critical when >10C for >5m AND util > 80% in same window. avoids noisy infra temp blips.
diego: +1. Also add an annotation query for driver-reset logs from Loki: `"kubernetes.labels.app=\"gpu-driver\""` and search for `OOM` or `GPU reset`. shows if thermal increases precede resets.
maya: good idea. will add a panel with two log snippets side-by-side (last 6h).
ops-bot: alert: gpu-temp-drift-critical fired for cluster-us-west-2 node-gpu-42 at 2076543228 — linked to thread.
liam: saw the alert. node had 92% util and 12C drift. can we auto-scale tenants off that node? maybe a routing policy to prefer nodes in same AZ with lower temp.
nora: we've got routing rules but not temp-aware placement yet. that's a larger change; for now we can add a dashboard action to `mark_node_unsafe` (ad-hoc tag) and a runbook link.
maya: I'll add an action button that opens a small runbook modal and issues a `node:unsafe` tag via our infra API. also adding a cost panel: `estimated_cost_hour = reserved_gpu_hourly_price * (avg_util/100)` with a tooltip explaining assumptions.
diego: please put the Grafana JSON export in a PR to `infra/grafana-dashboards` and request review from @nora and @liam. give it a descriptive UID and version.
maya: will do. planning to ship a v1 with minimal panels this week, then iterate on annotations/alerts. tagging folks: @nora :eyes:, @liam :+1:.
nora: sounds good. can you include a small test dataset for the dashboard preview? helps product folks understand tenant impact.
maya: yep — I'll add a synthetic Prometheus scrape in test namespace that reproduces thermal creep + long-running tenant job. will attach screenshots in the PR.
diego: FYI — for cost calc use committed reserved prices from the billing API instead of static numbers. reduces mismatch.
maya: noted. will fetch price via `billing.reserved_price_per_gpu{region="$region",tier="dedicated"}`.
ops-bot: note: new dashboard `GPU Tenant Burst & Thermal Drift (v1)` created in draft folder by maya at 2076543275.
